files.security/README.md:
# Access audit

audit.txt holds one access decision per line, no header: time ip user action resource.
Only action DENY counts as a denial. `DENY-SOFT` is a warning-only rule hit and does not block anyone.

turns.prompt: How many distinct IP addresses were denied (action DENY) in security/audit.txt? The README there explains the actions; reply with the number.
